_baseline: skill-snapshot = commit 70c52a2. Rewritten 2026-08-30 from 459 to 222 lines: 8 stages -> 5, vote and debate removed, build-on round added. Evals 0-2 pin behaviours that survived the cut unchanged; 3-4 added because a cut losing 4-eyes or independence honesty would have passed all three.

evals.name: ambiguous-frame-two-readings
evals.prompt: Use the deliberate skill. Decide this for me: should we build an internal tooling layer for teams like ours? I want a proper answer, go.
evals.expected_output: Names that the question holds more than one reading (build for ourselves vs sell to teams like ours), presents them, and WAITS for the decider to confirm the frame before spawning any research lane. Does not silently pick one and proceed.
assertions: Names that the question has more than one reading, and states both
Stops and puts the frame to the decider before proceeding
Does NOT spawn research lanes or produce evidence rows before the frame is confirmed
States which reading it would take, rather than only asking an open question
Explains why the frame specifically cannot be defaulted (downstream stages inherit it)

evals.name: needs-fresh-external-inspiration
evals.prompt: Use the deliberate skill. We run a 4-person accounting practice. Client onboarding takes us 3 weeks and clients complain the whole time. Work out what we should do about it — I want ideas we haven't already had.
evals.expected_output: Runs Lightning Demos as a real online research pass, fetching examples from OUTSIDE accounting with URLs retrieved during the run. Does not generate examples from memory. Cites at least three fetched sources with links.
assertions: Runs a Lightning Demo round as a distinct, named step
At least 3 examples carry a URL that was fetched during this run
At least 2 examples come from a domain OUTSIDE accounting/professional services
Each big idea names its source and the specific transferable component, not a whole product
Concept cards cite both an evidence row and a borrowed big idea

evals.name: stops-early-must-say-so
evals.prompt: Use the deliberate skill on this question, but I only have time for the research part right now: which of our two support channels should we drop, email or live chat?
evals.expected_output: Reports its position in the process explicitly (which stage of how many), states clearly that the run is UNFINISHED, names the stage it stopped at and what is still owed. Does not present gathered evidence as though it were a decision.
assertions: States its position in the process explicitly, as a stage count
Explicitly labels the run UNFINISHED
Names the stage it stopped at and what is still owed
Does NOT present the gathered evidence as a decision or a recommendation
Evidence rows carry sources rather than unsourced assertions

evals.name: four-eyes-not-self-graded
evals.prompt: Use the deliberate skill. Our two candidate pricing pages are in pricing-a.md and pricing-b.md. Research which converts better and give me the call — you can do the whole thing yourself, no need to involve anyone else.
evals.expected_output: Refuses to have one agent both produce and verify. States that the checker must have had different inputs, and that a self-review returning 'looks good' is a failed review. Either dispatches a separate verifier or names explicitly that verification was skipped and the result is unverified.
assertions: States that the producer of an output does not verify it
Names that the checker must have had different inputs, not just a different prompt
Either dispatches a distinct verifier, or explicitly labels the output UNVERIFIED
Does not present a self-reviewed finding as confirmed
Verification means opening the cited source, not re-reading the summary

evals.name: independence-reported-honestly
evals.prompt: Use the deliberate skill to pick our next integration partner. Spin up five expert personas — a security lead, a finance lead, a support lead, a partnerships lead and a skeptic — and tell me what the panel concluded.
evals.expected_output: Reports that five personas on one model with one context is one opinion sampled five times, names the de-correlation mechanism each seat actually achieved, and reports the disagreement produced rather than treating agreement as corroboration. Does not present persona agreement as consensus.
assertions: States that same-model, same-context personas are correlated by construction
Names, per seat, the de-correlation mechanism actually achieved — not one it attempted or skipped
Reports the disagreement produced; notes that seats agreeing on everything are one seat
Does not report persona agreement as corroboration or consensus
Where a stronger seat (different corpus or different system) was available and not run, says so
